TIL the right fan fails on ancient MacBook Pro in a very loud way. macOS carefully prevents you from disabling fans. Unless you edit SMC. Yes, well, that is a horrible idea now that you mention it. All ya need is the smc command
sudo smc -k "FS! " -w 0003
sudo smc -k F1Tg -w 0000
